title: Investigating the Effects of Fairness Interventions Using Pointwise Representational Similarity

measurement_description: The paper introduces a metric, Pointwise Normalized Kernel Alignment (PNKA), to measure the effects of fairness interventions on the intermediate representations of individuals. The specific application of this measurement in the paper is focused on biases related to race and gender, not religion or faith.
